content: Brigid could smell the same burning smell coming from Nemos. It reminded her of the obsessions that only the dead could have.

speaker: The Exiled King
content: Who are you waiting for? Death? Are you just waiting for it to pat you on the back so you can have a nice little race together?

speaker: Brigid
content: ...Who is that?

raw: [name="The Exiled King"]Oh. I forgot you could hear me.
speaker: The Exiled King
content: Oh. I forgot you could hear me.

raw: [name="Brigid"]I can hear you. I can even sense your presence... but I can't see you.
speaker: Brigid
content: I can hear you. I can even sense your presence... but I can't see you.

speaker: The Exiled King
content: Leave the city, outsider.

raw: [name="Brigid"]You're an outsider too, by the sound of it.
speaker: Brigid
content: You're an outsider too, by the sound of it.

speaker: The Exiled King
content: Naturally. Consider it advice from one outsider to another.

raw: [name="The Exiled King"]Live, Brigid. Nothing is more important than being alive. This city will be dead by sunrise tomorrow.
speaker: The Exiled King
content: Live, Brigid. Nothing is more important than being alive. This city will be dead by sunrise tomorrow.

raw: [name="The Exiled King"]Listen to Nemos. Find her kinsmen, run as far as you can, and never look back.
speaker: The Exiled King
content: Listen to Nemos. Find her kinsmen, run as far as you can, and never look back.

speaker: Brigid
content: ...You're right. I should go.

speaker: Brigid
content: But I will be back.

speaker: The Exiled King
content: Back?!

raw: [name="The Exiled King"]Hah! Stubbornness and stupidity really are hereditary!
speaker: The Exiled King
content: Hah! Stubbornness and stupidity really are hereditary!

raw: [name="The Exiled King"]You're going to come back after she tried so hard to get you out of here?
speaker: The Exiled King
content: You're going to come back after she tried so hard to get you out of here?

raw: [name="Brigid"]So you also think it was just an excuse to keep me safe?
speaker: Brigid
content: So you also think it was just an excuse to keep me safe?

raw: [name="The Exiled King"]What else could it be? You really think you can sway those wood-brains? Maybe if you waited for spring, one of their brains would sprout and they might come with you to the Dark Woods!
speaker: The Exiled King
content: What else could it be? You really think you can sway those wood-brains? Maybe if you waited for spring, one of their brains would sprout and they might come with you to the Dark Woods!

raw: [name="Brigid"]I don't like the way you talk, invisible brother.
speaker: Brigid
content: I don't like the way you talk, invisible brother.

raw: [name="The Exiled King"]What did you call me? Brother?
speaker: The Exiled King
content: What did you call me? Brother?

raw: [name="Brigid"]You have burnt stench, but other than that, you remind me of the nomads. No clue how you're related to us, but it feels right.
speaker: Brigid
content: You have burnt stench, but other than that, you remind me of the nomads. No clue how you're related to us, but it feels right.

speaker: The Exiled King
content: Haha... hahahahaha!

raw: [name="The Exiled King"]Let's make a bet then, Brigid.
speaker: The Exiled King
content: Let's make a bet then, Brigid.

speaker: Brigid
content: A bet?

raw: [name="The Exiled King"]On whether you'll be back tonight, before Na Saoirsí is burned to the ground. I say it's impossible.
speaker: The Exiled King
content: On whether you'll be back tonight, before Na Saoirsí is burned to the ground. I say it's impossible.

raw: [name="Brigid"]That's not what you really want to bet on.
speaker: Brigid
content: That's not what you really want to bet on.

raw: [name="The Exiled King"]Oh yeah? Then tell me, what I'm really thinking?
speaker: The Exiled King
content: Oh yeah? Then tell me, what I'm really thinking?

raw: [name="Brigid"]You just want to prove that you're right, that nothing is more important than being alive. You think I'll choose survival in the end.
speaker: Brigid
content: You just want to prove that you're right, that nothing is more important than being alive. You think I'll choose survival in the end.

speaker: Brigid
content: But whatever. You're on.

raw: [name="The Exiled King"]Well, what are you waiting for then?
speaker: The Exiled King
content: Well, what are you waiting for then?

raw: [name="Brigid"]It just doesn't feel fair. If you win, I'll live the rest of my life in regret. But if I win, it doesn't really matter to a bystander like you.
speaker: Brigid
content: It just doesn't feel fair. If you win, I'll live the rest of my life in regret. But if I win, it doesn't really matter to a bystander like you.

raw: [name="Brigid"]So how about this? If I win, you go back to where you came from.
speaker: Brigid
content: So how about this? If I win, you go back to where you came from.

raw: [name="The Exiled King"]And where do you think I should go back to?
speaker: The Exiled King
content: And where do you think I should go back to?

raw: [name="Brigid"]No idea, but not here. This isn't your home.
speaker: Brigid
content: No idea, but not here. This isn't your home.

raw: [name="Brigid"]You sound like you've been betrayed by the cityfolk here before, but you still can't bring yourself to hurt them.
speaker: Brigid
content: You sound like you've been betrayed by the cityfolk here before, but you still can't bring yourself to hurt them.

raw: [name="Brigid"]You act like you want to see them reap what they sowed, but didn't sound happy at all when you talked about the city burning to the ground.
speaker: Brigid
content: You act like you want to see them reap what they sowed, but didn't sound happy at all when you talked about the city burning to the ground.

raw: [name="Brigid"]Honestly, you're the most struggling person I ever met, and—
speaker: Brigid
content: Honestly, you're the most struggling person I ever met, and—

speaker: The Exiled King
content: Enough!

raw: [name="The Exiled King"]Very well. If you win, I'll return to where I belong.

content: Very well. If you win, I'll return to where I belong.

content: But just coming back here to die won't cut it.

speaker: Brigid
content: What else do you need me to do then?

speaker: The Exiled King
content: Deliver a message to those wood-brains outside the city. Tell them...

content: Uh... What?

content: Pass that on to those fools verbatim, especially the filthier bits. Did you get all that? Need me to repeat myself?

content: Then go.

content: Was all of that just so you could tell me this?

content: *pant*... *pant*...

content: Made it in time...

content: Yes, come here, where it's warm and bright, where there's still life... yes, over here.

content: What? You want to pretend I don't exist again?

content: I won't let you.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: This light will never go out, not until true darkness falls.

The dark mist has come.

content: And you're not going anywhere until Nemos awakens them.

content: This is how death should be. But Nemos seems to hear an ethereal voice laughing in her ear.

content: Without hesitation, the wayward wakewoman lifts the limp body and tosses it into the coffin.

speaker: Nemos
content: So where are you now? Are you still watching us from somewhere, with that twisted smile of yours?

content: But this vessel, at least, is beyond your reach. Otherwise, you'd have burned me to ash by now.

content: You don't even know the answer, do you?

content: Flames from its tip engulf the coffin in an instant, spreading along the rope connecting it to Nemos and merging with the purple fire on her.

speaker: Nemos
content: You're mine now.

speaker: Nemos
content: I'll finish what Culann started.

raw: [name="Nemos"]Let's go, to those lowly, despicable places that suffered from the war you stole victory in.

content: You will be seen by all. Your death will be seen by all.

raw: [name="Nemos"]They will know that you are dead. That the proud, imperious red dragon is dead. 'Here lies Eblana Dublinn, in this coffin covered in freezing flames.'
speaker: Nemos
content: They will know that you are dead. That the proud, imperious red dragon is dead. 'Here lies Eblana Dublinn, in this coffin covered in freezing flames.'

content: But... what will they do then?

raw: [name="Nemos"]I pray that your death will wake them up, of course, as Loughshinny hoped.
speaker: Nemos
content: I pray that your death will wake them up, of course, as Loughshinny hoped.

raw: [name="Nemos"]That they'll know that the era you represented is over. That Na Saoirsí will escape this calamity. That Tara need not celebrate its rebirth with the death of a city.

content: That they'll know that the era you represented is over. That Na Saoirsí will escape this calamity. That Tara need not celebrate its rebirth with the death of a city.

content: But... heh...

content: Your fire must have gotten to my head, dragon.

content: Why is that I suddenly feel like the other ending... where it all ends in destruction... isn't so bad?

content: Someone else may have killed you, but...

content: This is my revenge.
